extracted.intended_audience: Chiefs and staff of the Legislative Liaison Division and Personnel Division, Personnel & Administration (internal agency personnel handling congressional employment references)
extracted.subtask_description: Internal administrative procedure for handling congressional calls/references about employment candidates (Forms 57), including referral, interview routing, notification, coordination, and timelines for final replies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate referral of congressional personnel communications
rubrics_metrics.description: All congressional calls and communications in connection with personnel matters will, immediately upon receipt, be referred to the Legislative Liaison Division of the Personnel and Administrative Branch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Referrals must occur upon initial receipt; do not handle such communications locally or outside the Legislative Liaison Division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request form 57 or applicant interview
rubrics_metrics.description: Request the congressional office concerned to either submit Form 57 for consideration or send applicant to that division for interview. Applicant should bring Form 57 with him.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legislative Liaison Division must prompt the congressional office to provide standardized documentation (Form 57) or arrange an in-person interview; ensure applicants come prepared with Form 57.

rubrics_metrics.name: Screen Form 57 / interview for qualification fit
rubrics_metrics.description: If examination of the Form 57 or result of interview indicates that applicant may possess qualifications currently needed by CIG, the Chief of the Legislative Liaison Division will arrange for an interview with the Chief of the Personnel Procurement Section or his deputy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Form 57 and interview outcomes as the basis for determining whether to escalate to Personnel Procurement leadership for placement consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure when no immediate qualifications found
rubrics_metrics.description: If examination of Form 57 or result of interview indicates no special qualifications of immediate interest to CIG, the applicant will be informed that his Form 57 will be reviewed and decision as to employment furnished him within two weeks. In such case no further interview will be arranged, but Form 57 will be forwarded to the Chief of the Personnel Division for further action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicate a clear two-week timeline to applicants when no immediate fit is found; forward documentation to Personnel Division for follow-up rather than scheduling additional interviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform congressional office of preliminary and final action
rubrics_metrics.description: Will inform the congressional office concerned of the above preliminary action and of the final decision when such decision has been made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legislative Liaison Division is responsible for keeping the referring congressional office apprised of both initial processing steps and the ultimate hiring decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate other personnel matters for expedition
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinate action on other types of personnel matters to insure expeditious completion and inform the congressional office concerned of action taken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Actively coordinate across divisions to speed resolution of related personnel issues and provide status updates to offices that made the referral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel Chief to require interviews by Procurement Chief or deputy
rubrics_metrics.description: Issue necessary instructions to the Chief of his Procurement Section to insure personal interview by himself or his deputy where interviews are arranged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When interviews are arranged, Procurement leadership (Chief or deputy) must personally conduct them; Personnel Chief must issue the instruction to enforce this.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expeditious processing of Forms 57 and provide basis for final reply
rubrics_metrics.description: Insure that Forms 57 in these cases, regardless of whether an interview has been necessary, are processed expeditiously and basis for final reply furnished the Legislative Liaison Division within 14 days in each case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personnel Division must process every Form 57 quickly and deliver the rationale/basis for the final reply back to Legislative Liaison within a 14-day deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform applicant within 14 days if no suitable position
rubrics_metrics.description: Insure that applicant is informed within 14 days if no suitable position exists currently for his employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must receive a decision about current suitability within 14 days; this is a firm notification timeline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide expeditious assistance to Legislative Liaison for prompt replies
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide expeditious assistance to the Legislative Liaison Division in other types of personnel cases to enable prompt and intelligent replies to be made to congressional offices in each case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Personnel Division should support Legislative Liaison with timely, well-informed input on diverse personnel matters so that congressional inquiries receive prompt, substantive responses.
